easy.def: A king in Russia long ago.
examples: The tsar lived in a palace.

more.def: The title of the ruler of Russia in the past.
examples: The tsar lived in a grand palace.
Russia was ruled by a tsar for hundreds of years.
The tsar rode in a golden carriage.

more.def: A very large, powerful sea wave, often caused by an earthquake under the ocean.
examples: A tsunami can flood a coast.
Scientists warn people when a tsunami may come.
The tsunami swept across the bay.
